description: `idempotency-store="postgres"` against `db="sqlite:./app.db"`. Per §39.2.6 the explicit store driver must match the `db=` driver, so E-CPS-IDEMPOTENCY-STORE-DRIVER-MISMATCH fires (§34: Error). It takes priority over the other two store diagnostics — an explicit-attribute contradiction is reported before a resolution outcome.
rationale: §39.2.6 — the idempotency store is a real table in a real database. Naming a driver that differs from the closest-ancestor `db=` asks the compiler to write keys to a connection the app does not have; `"auto"` exists precisely so the author does not have to restate the driver. The mismatch is decidable from two attributes, so it is a compile error rather than a connection failure at first retry.
